description: This file provides functions to convert between logr.Logger and slog.Handler, and defines the SlogSink interface for enhanced logging capabilities in Go 1.21+.

methods.name: FromSlogHandler
methods.description: Converts a slog.Handler to a logr.Logger, mapping verbosity levels.

methods.name: ToSlogHandler
methods.description: Converts a logr.Logger to a slog.Handler, supporting sink and verbosity adjustments.
